name: OSS Apparel
old_description: At OSS Apparel, we believe every customer is unique and are committed to providing personalized service that meets your specific needs. Our skilled team will work closely with you to understand your requirements and preferences and tailor our services accordingly. From product selection to design and printing, we strive to deliver a customized experience that exceeds your expectations.
about:
OSS Apparel operates from an 8,500-square-foot facility in East Providence, Rhode Island. The company was founded in 2015 by Mike Almeida, who began with a single heat press in a basement as a side hustle driven by a passion for entrepreneurship and hands-on creativity. Over the past decade, the business has grown into a full-service custom apparel shop rooted in Almeida’s blue-collar work ethic and local ties.

The shop provides screen printing, embroidery, direct-to-film (DTF) transfers, sublimation, banner production, promotional products, graphic design, and brand guide development. Production runs out of the East Providence facility, which added new equipment and a quality-assurance process during a recent re-grand opening. The team handles jobs ranging from one-off custom pieces to larger runs for schools, businesses, and organizations across the region.

Customers include schools, youth sports leagues, regional nonprofits, small businesses launching clothing lines, and corporate clients needing branded uniforms or event gear. OSS Apparel emphasizes word-of-mouth referrals and community partnerships, such as supporting local youth programs and collaborating with nonprofits to strengthen branding through apparel.

The company’s name stands for “Outstanding. Strategic. Service.”—a framework that guides its approach to personalized service, competitive pricing, a 100% satisfaction guarantee, and included graphic design support. Almeida started the venture to build something from the ground up, and the business now positions itself as a reliable print partner that prioritizes fast turnarounds and dependable quality.
